newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on fund, grain up on commercial.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on fund, grain up on commercial.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended higher on fund buying while commercial support buoyed feed grain values, traders said.
"There was good fund buying in November above $440 and they'll be back tomorrow," a trader said. Jan-Mar spread at $0.50, Nov-Jan $4. Volume was 2,225 lots, with 500 hedges.
November canola rose $3.20 to $442.30, breaking technical resistance at $440 and January settled up $3.40 at $446.10.
October flax rose $4 to $398.50 on commercial demand. Nov-Jan spread at $4.
October feed wheat finished $2.90 higher at $201.90 and December was up $1.90 at $186.40 on commercial demand. Volume was 730 lots.
Oats and feed peas did not trade.
November western barley rose $0.70 to $150.90, February up $0.50 to $155.40 on commercial buying. Volume was 700 lots.
"You'd think the snow and rain in Alberta would pressure the feed grains (by downgrading grain to feed) but we've got good commercial support here," a trader said.
(All values in Canadian dollars except oats, peas)
